about: Sou desenvolvedor de software com forte base em programacao competitiva, ciencia de dados e inteligencia artificial. Atuo de forma organizada e proativa, com foco em resolucao de problemas, qualidade de codigo e melhoria continua de processos. Tenho experiencia no desenvolvimento de sistemas web e back-end, automacao e analise de dados, alem da construcao e treinamento de modelos de aprendizado de maquina e aprendizado profundo.

Participo de projetos de software cientifico voltados a pesquisa, incluindo classificacao de imagens medicas com redes neurais convolucionais, integracao de dados clinicos e geracao de relatorios tecnicos e metricas de desempenho. Possuo dominio pratico de Python, SQL, C++, Java, JavaScript e Kotlin, bem como de frameworks e bibliotecas como Django, Flask, React, Pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch e Scikit-learn.

Tenho facilidade para trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicacao interpessoal e disciplina no cumprimento de prazos e padroes tecnicos. Busco aprendizado continuo e aprimoramento profissional, com interesse especial em algoritmos, estruturas de dados, desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes e aplicacoes de IA em contextos cientificos e educacionais.
Este portfolio demonstra um terminal Ubuntu no browser e uma GUI retro inspirada no Windows 95.

projects.name: SupaSport
projects.description: O objetivo do projeto e oferecer uma plataforma completa para que usuarios possam encontrar, reservar e pagar por horarios em estabelecimentos esportivos, como quadras e ginasios. Proprietarios de estabelecimentos tambem podem cadastrar e gerenciar seus locais de forma simples e intuitiva.
projects.details: Plataforma de reservas esportivas com foco em descoberta de locais, agendamento e pagamento. Inclui area do proprietario para cadastro e administracao de quadras e horarios.
lessons: Modelagem de disponibilidade e conflitos de reservas.
Separacao de fluxos entre usuario e proprietario com permissoes.
Integracao de pagamento e notificacoes.

projects.name: PIBIC Dermatologia
projects.description: E um aplicativo movel desenvolvido em React Native/Expo com o objetivo de auxiliar na analise preliminar de lesoes de pele.
projects.details: Aplicativo mobile voltado a triagem de lesoes de pele, com foco em uma experiencia simples para coleta de informacoes e suporte a pesquisa.
lessons: Pre-processamento e balanceamento de imagens para treino.
Otimizacao de desempenho no mobile.
Alinhamento de requisitos com area medica.

projects.name: Sistema de cadastro de alunos
projects.description: Sistema CRUD para cadastro de alunos com upload de imagens, desenvolvido em Django REST Framework.
projects.details: API REST para cadastro de alunos com suporte a upload de imagens e operacoes CRUD completas.
lessons: Upload seguro de imagens e validacao de formatos.
Serializacao e consistencia dos endpoints REST.
Automacao de CRUD com testes basicos.

projects.name: Crud de um banco de dados em python
projects.description: Um pequeno CRUD de banco de dados em Python.
projects.details: Projeto simples de CRUD em Python para operacoes basicas em banco de dados.
lessons: Tratamento de erros e validacao de entradas.
Modelagem simples de tabelas e consultas.

projects.name: get-shop
projects.description: API que converte pedidos recebidos via WhatsApp e arquivos CSV em registros de estoque estruturados automaticamente.
projects.details: Back-end em Python e FastAPI com endpoints REST para ingestao e gestao de inventario a partir de fontes semi-estruturadas como mensagens e planilhas.
lessons: Parsing de formatos semi-estruturados (mensagens WhatsApp, CSV).
Design de APIs REST com validacao automatica via Pydantic.
Gestao de estado de estoque com controle de erros robusto.

projects.name: PW_100
projects.description: Monitor de arbitragem de criptomoedas com rastreamento de precos em tempo real e alertas automaticos entre exchanges.
projects.details: Plataforma full-stack para deteccao de oportunidades de arbitragem, com visualizacao de graficos ao vivo e sistema de alertas configuravel.
lessons: Sincronizacao de dados em tempo real com polling e WebSockets.
Modelagem de series temporais em MongoDB.
Integracao com APIs de exchanges com tratamento de rate limiting.

projects.name: Rodando Moto Center
projects.description: Sistema web completo para gestao de uma moto center: clientes, ordens de servico, estoque e financeiro.
projects.details: Plataforma full-stack com back-end Spring Boot, front-end React e banco PostgreSQL containerizado com Docker, com deploy ao vivo no Vercel.
lessons: Arquitetura REST com Spring Boot e JPA/Hibernate.
Containerizacao com Docker Compose para dev e producao.
Deploy full-stack com separacao de responsabilidades entre servicos.

projects.name: Mundo de Libras
projects.description: Site educacional para aprendizado de Lingua Brasileira de Sinais (Libras) com conteudo organizado por categorias tematicas.
projects.details: Plataforma web com navegacao por temas — saudacoes, tecnologia, turismo, cultura e agricultura — para facilitar o aprendizado inclusivo de Libras.
lessons: Estruturacao de conteudo acessivel e navegavel para diferentes publicos.
Organizacao tematica de vocabulario em JavaScript puro.
Foco em acessibilidade e inclusao digital desde o design.

education.institution: Instituto Federal de Educação, Ciência e Tecnologia do Amazonas, IFAM Campus Parintins

about: I am a software developer with a strong background in competitive programming, data science, and artificial intelligence. I work in an organized and proactive way, focusing on problem solving, code quality, and continuous process improvement. I have experience developing web and back-end systems, automation, and data analysis, as well as building and training machine learning and deep learning models.

I participate in scientific software projects aimed at research, including medical image classification with convolutional neural networks, clinical data integration, and generation of technical reports and performance metrics. I have practical experience with Python, SQL, C++, Java, JavaScript, and Kotlin, as well as frameworks and libraries such as Django, Flask, React, Pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Scikit-learn.

I work well in teams, communicate clearly, and stay disciplined with deadlines and technical standards. I pursue continuous learning and professional growth, with a special interest in algorithms, data structures, intelligent systems development, and AI applications in scientific and educational contexts.
This portfolio demonstrates an Ubuntu-like terminal in the browser and a retro GUI inspired by Windows 95.

projects.name: SupaSport
projects.description: The project aims to provide a complete platform for users to find, book, and pay for time slots at sports facilities such as courts and gyms. Facility owners can also register and manage their locations in a simple and intuitive way.
projects.details: Sports booking platform focused on discovery, scheduling, and payments. Includes an owner area to register and manage courts and time slots.
lessons: Modeled availability and avoided booking conflicts.
Separated user and owner flows with permissions.
Integrated payments and notifications.

projects.name: PIBIC Dermatologia
projects.description: A mobile app built with React Native/Expo to assist in the preliminary analysis of skin lesions.
projects.details: Mobile app focused on skin lesion screening with a simple experience for data collection and research support.
lessons: Image preprocessing and dataset balancing.
Mobile performance optimization.
Aligned requirements with medical stakeholders.

projects.name: Student registration system
projects.description: CRUD system for student registration with image upload, built with Django REST Framework.
projects.details: REST API for student registration with image upload support and full CRUD operations.
lessons: Secure image upload and format validation.
Serialization consistency across REST endpoints.
CRUD automation with basic tests.

projects.name: Database CRUD in Python
projects.description: A small database CRUD in Python.
projects.details: Simple Python CRUD project for basic database operations.
lessons: Error handling and input validation.
Simple table modeling and queries.

projects.name: get-shop
projects.description: API that converts WhatsApp messages and CSV files into structured inventory records automatically.
projects.details: Python and FastAPI back-end with REST endpoints for inventory ingestion and management from semi-structured sources such as messages and spreadsheets.
lessons: Parsing semi-structured formats (WhatsApp messages, CSV).
REST API design with automatic validation via Pydantic.
Inventory state management with robust error handling.

projects.name: PW_100
projects.description: Cryptocurrency arbitrage monitor with real-time price tracking and automatic alerts across exchanges.
projects.details: Full-stack platform for detecting arbitrage opportunities, with live chart visualization and a configurable alert system.
lessons: Real-time data sync with polling and WebSockets.
Time-series data modeling in MongoDB.
Exchange API integration with rate limiting handling.

projects.name: Rodando Moto Center
projects.description: Full-stack web system for managing a motorcycle center: customers, service orders, inventory, and financials.
projects.details: Full-stack platform with Spring Boot back-end, React front-end, and PostgreSQL database containerized with Docker, deployed live on Vercel.
lessons: REST architecture with Spring Boot and JPA/Hibernate.
Containerization with Docker Compose for dev and production.
Full-stack deployment with proper service separation.

projects.name: Mundo de Libras
projects.description: Educational website for learning Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) with content organized by thematic categories.
projects.details: Web platform with navigation by theme — greetings, technology, tourism, culture, and agriculture — to facilitate inclusive Libras learning.
lessons: Structuring accessible content for diverse audiences.
Thematic vocabulary organization in plain JavaScript.
Accessibility and digital inclusion as core design principles.
